inputs.notes: Base FCF is TTM through Q1-2026 = FY2025 2,874 - Q1'25 534 + Q1'26 824 = 3,164M EUR. Net debt = Total Debt - (Cash + ST Investments) = 476 - 8,746 = -8,270 (net cash). Exchangeable Notes (US$1.5B / EUR1,304M) MATURED and were settled in cash in March 2026, so total debt is now only lease liabilities (476M). Shares outstanding fell to 205.6M (209.74M issued less 4.12M treasury) on buybacks. Financials reported in EUR; stock trades in USD on NYSE. EURUSD 1.1392 used for USD conversion (materially stronger EUR than prior 1.05 run, which lifts USD intrinsic values).

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (41-51%) and FCF CAGR (79-488%) diverge sharply from Revenue CAGR (14-17%) because Spotify only turned its first full-year operating profit in FY2024 after posting net losses through FY2023. FCF rose from a near-zero EUR 21M (FY2022) to EUR 2,874M (FY2025) / EUR 3,164M TTM. These are step-changes from a profitability inflection, not sustainable compounding. EPS CAGR is not meaningful (negative base years). Revenue CAGR (14-17%) is the most stable baseline and drives the forward projections.

base.rationale: Growth starts near the 5yr revenue CAGR (16.9%) and decelerates to 10% by Year 5. Base FCF is TTM EUR 3,164M (FY2025 plus the Q1-2026 step-up). WACC 10% for a large-cap profitable global audio platform with EUR/USD FX exposure and a structural royalty cost ceiling.

bull.rationale: Pricing power compounds (US Individual $12.99/mo), MAUs push toward 900M+, audiobooks and the Spotify Partner Program scale, Spotify Ad Exchange accelerates programmatic ad revenue, and FCF margin expands to 20% on marketplace royalty programs and operating leverage. Lower WACC as profitability is firmly established.

bear.rationale: Apple/Amazon/YouTube Music intensify bundling and device-preload advantages, label royalty renegotiations compress margins, FX headwinds persist, developed markets saturate and emerging-market monetization disappoints. FCF margin stalls at 14%. Higher WACC reflects co-CEO transition and geopolitical execution risk.

sensitivity.notes: Base case FCF path (growth [18,16,14,12,10]%, base FCF 3164M EUR TTM) used in every cell; only WACC and terminal growth vary. Values in USD (EUR x 1.1392). Net cash 8270M EUR added. Current price $462.29 sits near the WACC=10%, terminal=3% base cell ($454.78).

sanity_check.diagnosis: No trip. Base-case implied EV/FCF ~24x and EV/Revenue ~4.4x are reasonable for a profitable, ~15% revenue-growth global platform and are in line with (not above) what the market currently pays. Base-case upside is only -1.6%, far from the >100% threshold. FCF base is TTM, not a cyclical peak. No structural single-customer / small-cap / cyclicality risks warranting a WACC premium.

valuation_multiples_at_current_price.notes: Market cap = $462.29 x 205.6M = $95047.0M = EUR 83433.0M. EV = Market Cap EUR - Net Cash 8270 = 75163.0M EUR. EV/FCF on TTM FCF 3164M.

key_insights: At $462.29, Spotify trades almost exactly on its base-case intrinsic value ($454.78, -1.6%). The probability-weighted IV $469.62 is +1.6% vs price - essentially fairly valued on a risk-adjusted basis.

Currency basis matters: financials are in EUR, the stock trades in USD. A materially stronger EUR (EURUSD 1.1392 vs 1.05 at the prior run) raised USD intrinsic values ~8% independent of any operating change.
Base FCF updated to TTM EUR 3164M (through Q1-2026) from FY2025's EUR 2,874M; Q1-2026 FCF was EUR 824M (+54% Y/Y).
Q1-2026: revenue EUR 4,533M (+8% Y/Y), operating income EUR 715M (15.8% margin), diluted EPS EUR 3.45, Premium Subscribers 293M (+9% Y/Y), MAUs 761M (+12% Y/Y), Premium ARPU EUR 4.76.
Balance sheet de-risked: the US$1.5B Exchangeable Notes matured and were settled in CASH in March 2026, leaving only EUR 476M of lease liabilities. Net cash is EUR 8270M (~10% of market cap).
Bull case $705.63 (+52.6%) needs 25%-decel-to-16% FCF growth and 20% FCF margin; bear case $263.29 (-43.0%) on saturation and margin compression.
Sanity check passed: base-case implied EV/FCF ~24x and EV/Revenue ~4.4x are consistent with current market multiples and below historical peaks for a profitable ~15%-grower.
